result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but some horizontally scrolling content is visibly cut off at the right edge, which can look unfinished or accidental.

issues.description: The rightmost item in the “Fastest near you” carousel is cut off mid-card, including its restaurant name (“Trattoria Piccol…”), without a clear overflow treatment such as an ellipsis or visible carousel affordance.
issues.suggestion: Use consistent title truncation with an ellipsis, add spacing/peek behavior that clearly signals horizontal scrolling, and ensure clipped cards do not appear abruptly cut off.

issues.description: The category row ends with a partially visible, unlabeled pill at the right edge, making the horizontal overflow look like a rendering artifact.
issues.suggestion: Show a more intentional partial next category with readable text, add a fade/scroll indicator, or adjust the initial scroll position so the overflow is clearer.
